doc: A network of wall or fence lines on the hex grid's diagonal lattice (design/planner.md, Walls, fences, and gates): nodes are cells on one of the three diagonal sublattices (cells two apart across a corner), and every link joins nodes along a line through opposite corners, running vertex to vertex through each cell and along the edge between the next two, so lines stay straight and meet at 60 and 120 degrees.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The network's name (an example in config/line_networks/).

fields.name: nodes
fields.doc: Its nodes, as q, r pairs (axial, pointy-top): all with the same (q - r) mod 3.

fields.name: links
fields.doc: Its links, as pairs of node indices: nodes on one diagonal line (q, r) + k (2, -1), (1, 1), or (-1, 2); a long link runs through the nodes between.

fields.name: gate_nodes
fields.doc: Nodes that hold a gate: the line passes straight through them, and the opening is 3 m, centred on the node.

fields.name: gate_links
fields.doc: Links (by index) that hold a gate at their middle: the opening is the link's 3 m.

fields.name: towers
fields.doc: Nodes that hold a tower (besides those its kind's rules add).
